title: TopoMap: A Feature-based Discriminator of the Topographical Regions in the Test Input Space
abstract: arXiv:2509.03242v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Testing Deep Learning (DL)-based systems is an open challenge. Although it is relatively easy to find inputs that cause a DL model to misbehave, the grouping of such inputs by features that make them problematic for the DL model under test is largely unexplored. In this work, we propose TopoMap, a model-agnostic approach that relies solely on features that characterise inputs to construct a partitioning of the input space where each region represents a specific set of distinguishable input features. Such a partitioning gives users a possibility to identify and analyse areas that are under-represented, show higher failure rates, or exhibit prediction changes after a model update. The identified regions of interest can then be used for additional data generation or can help prioritise already generated inputs that require labelling efforts. translated_title: TopoMap：一种基于特征的测试输入空间拓扑区域判别器
translated_abstract: 测试基于深度学习的系统是一项尚未解决的挑战。虽然找到导致深度学习模型出现错误行为的输入相对容易，但如何根据使这些输入对被测深度学习模型产生问题的特征来对它们进行分组，在很大程度上仍未被探索。在这项工作中，我们提出了TopoMap，这是一种模型无关的方法，仅依赖刻画输入的特征来构建输入空间的一种划分，其中每个区域代表一组特定的、可区分的输入特征。这样的划分为用户提供了一种可能性，即识别并分析那些代表性不足、失败率较高，或在模型更新后表现出预测变化的区域。随后，这些被识别的感兴趣区域可用于额外的数据生成，或帮助对已生成的、需要标注工作的输入进行优先级排序。为了根据输入所共有的特定特征对输入进行判别，我们首先应用降维……
tldr: TopoMap是一种模型无关的方法，通过基于输入特征对测试输入空间进行拓扑划分，帮助用户识别代表性不足、失败率高或模型更新后预测发生变化的区域，从而指导数据生成和标注工作的优先级排序。
en_tdlr: TopoMap is a model-agnostic approach that partitions the test input space based on input features, enabling users to identify under-represented regions, high failure-rate areas, and prediction changes after model updates, thereby guiding data generation and labelling prioritization.
